data.case_title: Heating maintenance invoice from Heizungsbau Beispielwärme GmbH
data.explanation: This is an invoice from the heating company for the annual maintenance of your gas heating system on 23 November 2026. It asks you to pay €258.11 by the deadline shown (10 days from the invoice date). Transfer the amount to the IBAN given, referencing the invoice if you like. If you dispute any item, contact the company directly - no formal legal remedy is attached to this invoice. Keep this invoice, as craftsman labour costs (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be partly deducted on your German tax return - a tax advisor can confirm the details.
